name: HealthMe
tagline: A voice health assistant that finds a nearby clinic and phones it to book for you.

awards: Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité
MentorMates - Sponsor Challenge // MentorMates - Défi commandité

problem: Finding a clinic that can see you while sick takes call after call.
solution: Gemini chat with health context, a clinic map, and an AI phone agent (ElevenLabs, Twilio) that talks to the receptionist, with a live transcript.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for care and watch the agent call the clinic.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité” and “MentorMates - Sponsor Challenge // MentorMates - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
The agent makes the real phone call.

lessons: A live phone call is the demo; everything else supports it.
